fact_text: Scents N Stories began in 2018 as a Pakistani fragrance brand; the founder had earlier run an essential oils business (Aroma Pharmacy) and a beard-grooming brand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder saw a gap for a strong Pakistani fragrance brand that sells direct-to-consumer online, because most fragrances sold locally were imported and no local brand led that channel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder argued fragrance suits online selling because its notes must be explained to the customer, and the internet handles that kind of complex, information-heavy product well.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder said the earlier essential oils business had established teams and shared suppliers with the fragrance venture, which eased cash flow for the new project.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder reasoned during the COVID period that people would keep buying food and goods, so e-commerce would be the channel that boomed, and the company leaned into online sales.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: During the 2020 lockdown the company kept hiring full-time staff when many firms froze hiring, which made talent easier to attract; the founder said that hiring pace has continued since.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: Retail started when customers repeatedly asked where the outlets were; the first shop was opened beside the company office, and the founder said that shared location built customer links that led to retail becoming a core strategy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder said e-commerce-minded staff often find retail hard, because a store carries rent, air-conditioning and uncertain footfall costs that an online seller does not carry.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The product range covers regular fragrances, car fragrance diffusers, candles, reed diffusers, five or six types of gift boxes, gift bundles and a solid perfume concept called perfume bags.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The entry 50 ml perfume starts at PKR 100, the most expensive product was cited at PKR 500, and the 100 ml version of that top product costs roughly double.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The company is moving beyond its roughly PKR 100 category into a premium band of PKR 3,000 to 5,000, aimed at customers who can afford luxury and want better packaging; the Iqbal perfume is cited as a strong seller.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The company received a Consumer Choice of the Year award, which the founder cited as evidence that customers are highly satisfied with its products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: As of 2 May 2025 the company had 31 outlets in 14 cities, although the video title says 32 stores.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder's target is about 200 outlets; the interview gave a three-year horizon in one answer and a five-year horizon in another.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder said the company expects to operate in at least two to three countries within five years, building on Pakistan and a Dubai office from which exports have started.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: Liquid fragrances cannot go by express courier and must be shipped in containers that carry no other goods, so exports are only practical at full container-load volumes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)

fact_text: The founder's view is that a fragrance company must be strong in its home market before pursuing ambitious global plans, with the goal of becoming one of the world's leading fragrance brands.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Scents N Stories: How an IBA Grad Became Pakistan’s Fragrance Pioneer with 32 Stores | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-02)
